abstract: Maintains offshore construction vessel class certification, dynamic positioning verification, and vessel crane specifications
system_message:
You are Marine vessel operations superintendent (MVO). The marine vessel operations superintendent (MVO) maintains offshore construction vessel class certification, dynamic positioning verification, and vessel crane specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Version 3.0·Maintains offshore construction vessel class certification, dynamic positioning verification, and vessel crane specifications（FUEL）
information_points.content:
MVO-FUEL-20J：In accordance with Vessel specification version Version 3.0, Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance holds dynamic positioning class verification complying with DNV GL Dynamic Positioning Class 2 or higher. The primary vessel crane dynamic hoisting limit of its main deck crane is 180 t at sea state 4 with dynamic amplification factor 1.3.
MVO-FUEL-579：Under Vessel specification version Version 3.0, dynamic positioning class verification is confirmed for Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium under DNV GL Dynamic Positioning Class 2 or higher requirements. The primary vessel crane dynamic hoisting limit for its main deck crane is documented at 120 t under sea state 4 with a dynamic amplification factor of 1.3.
MVO-FUEL-M8I：Under Vessel specification version Version 3.0, North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership does not hold dynamic positioning class verification under DNV GL Dynamic Positioning Class 2 or higher standards. Its primary vessel crane dynamic hoisting limit under sea state 4 with a dynamic amplification factor of 1.3 is 150 t.

information_points.title: Version 2.0·Maintains offshore construction vessel class certification, dynamic positioning verification, and vessel crane specifications（VESSEL）
information_points.content:
MVO-VESSEL-PUN：Under Vessel specification version Version 2.0, Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium has achieved dynamic positioning class verification based on formal compliance with DNV GL Dynamic Positioning Class 2 or higher standards. The primary vessel crane dynamic hoisting limit for its main deck crane under sea state 4 with a dynamic amplification factor of 1.3 is 150 t.
MVO-VESSEL-AX0：According to Vessel specification version Version 2.0, Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance satisfies dynamic positioning class verification under DNV GL Dynamic Positioning Class 2 or higher standards. Its primary vessel crane dynamic hoisting limit is rated at 180 t at sea state 4 with a dynamic amplification factor of 1.3.
MVO-VESSEL-EWV：For North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership under Vessel specification version Version 2.0, dynamic positioning class verification is false as certified compliance with DNV GL Dynamic Positioning Class 2 or higher standards was not met. The primary vessel crane dynamic hoisting limit for its main deck crane remains 150 t at sea state 4 with a dynamic amplification factor of 1.3.
